text:
noah: Starting a compact follow-up thread from the vendor outage postmortem. I pulled action items that need owners + short ETAs. Reply with "ack + ETA" and add links when available.

yana: Ack. Paste the items please.

noah: Short list: (A) emergency artifact fallback (cross-cloud read-only mirror), (B) model-registry auth backoff + cached manifests, (C) auth provider token-refresh single-flight + healthcheck, (D) vendor escalation/contact card + SLA ask, (E) runbook drill schedule + monthly recurrence dashboard.

leo: I'll take (B). Plan: store last-known manifests in redis with 8m TTL and serve cached metadata up to 60s on registry timeouts. Add integration test simulating 503s. ETA branch by 2026-03-29.

isabel: I'll own (C). Implement single-flight refresh and a synthetic healthcheck that validates token issuance every 60s. Also add rate-limit backoff to avoid stampedes. ETA: 2026-03-26.

noah: @leo add a small telemetry event when serving cached manifest (fields: event_type, reason, duration_ms, owner).

leo: Will add.

vendor-eng: For (D) I'll add a primary + escalation backup contact for provider-B and request a faster P1 engagement path. Draft update by 2026-03-23 COB.

isabel: For (A) recommend a manual failover runbook first (copy artifacts to backup bucket) and then an automated sync later. I can draft runbook steps but need infra help for the sync. ETA runbook draft 2026-04-04.

yana: I'll own the monthly recurrence dashboard and add a panel counting vendor-related incidents over 90/180d. ETA: 2026-04-01.

ops-bot: Follow-up ticket INC-2026-512 created and linked.

noah: Recap owners/ETAs: leo (cached manifests) -> 2026-03-29; isabel (token single-flight + healthcheck) -> 2026-03-26; isabel (fallback runbook draft) -> 2026-04-04; vendor-eng (contacts + SLA ask) -> 2026-03-23; yana (recurrence dashboard) -> 2026-04-01.

yana: I'll add a recurring calendar reminder for the incident-pattern review on the 1st of each month.

leo: Draft PR link will go into INC-2026-512 when ready.

isabel: I'll open the token changes RFC and link the PR to the ticket.

vendor-eng: Contact card uploaded to INC-2026-512 and provider-B pinged.

noah: Thanks all. Please react with :white_check_mark: in the ticket when PRs or docs are linked. We'll review progress in the weekly triage.
